sn1.77:1.1: Kiṃsu issariyaṃ loke || kiṃsu bhaṇḍānam uttamaṃ || kiṃsu satthamalaṃ loke || kiṃsu lokasmim abbudaṃ || ||
sn1.77:2.1: kiṃsu harantaṃ vārenti || haranto pana ko piyo || kiṃsu punappanāyantaṃ || abhinandanti paṇḍitāti || ||
sn1.77:3.1: Vaso issariyaṃ loke || itthi bhaṇḍānam uttamaṃ || kodho satthamalam loke || corā lokasmim abbudā || ||
sn1.77:4.1: coram harantaṃ vārenti || haranto samaṇo piyo || samaṇam punappunāyantaṃ || abhinandanti paṇḍitāti || ||
